Python binding for FEMM 5 (femm-qt), copied unchanged from the femm-qt source
release `femm-qt-py-src_06oct2026_bd03d0b.zip` (https://femm.info, `pyfemm/`).
MIT License, Copyright (C) 2026 David Meeker and contributors.
It talks to `femm_gui` / `femm_headless` over TCP; install FEMM 5 itself as
described in ../README.md.
